verdict.rationale: Auth0 ships an official MCP Server (auth0-mcp-server) documented on their docs site and GitHub, letting AI agents like Claude Desktop, Cursor, or Windsurf connect via OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization to manage the tenant (create apps, deploy Actions, manage users, debug logs). This is a first-party, well-documented server-side MCP integration with both docs and GitHub repo corroboration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party review of the MCP server's reliability in production use.
